===============================================================================
HOME  (/index.html)
===============================================================================

Turn your data into intelligent workflows and better decisions.

Azra Analytics designs and develops end-to-end data, machine learning, and AI systems. We
combine business strategy, workflow architecture, data engineering, predictive modeling, and
AI application development to build solutions that create measurable organizational value.

Strategy-driven. Open-source-first. Built for your operating environment.

Why it matters: AI is becoming ubiquitous. Competitive advantage is not. Sustainable value
comes from integrating data, analytics, machine learning, AI, human expertise, and
organizational knowledge into the workflows that determine how the organization operates and
makes decisions. Azra Analytics is a strategy-driven data and AI development firm combining
expertise in business strategy, operations, data engineering, machine learning, and AI
development.

Our Services (from business problem to production-ready data and AI system): Azra Analytics
assists organizations in identifying valuable AI opportunities, establishing data
foundations, and creating intelligent systems that enhance workflows and decisions. Services
can address focused projects or comprehensive transformations.

- Strategy and Workflow Design — identify the workflows, decisions, and operational
  challenges where data, machine learning, and AI can create measurable value; translate
  those opportunities into a practical implementation roadmap.
- Machine Learning and Decision Systems — predictive and analytical models that support
  important business decisions, from forecasting and anomaly detection to risk assessment,
  optimization, and operational planning.
- Data Ingestion and Engineering — connect fragmented data sources and build reliable
  pipelines, data models, and analytical foundations; trusted, accessible data for
  reporting, machine learning, and AI applications.
- AI Application Development — practical AI applications that integrate models,
  organizational knowledge, and human judgment into everyday workflows: intelligent
  assistants, recommendation systems, document-processing tools, and custom decision-support
  applications.

SERVICES  (/services.html)
===============================================================================

Our Services. We connect strategy, workflow design, data engineering, machine learning, and
AI application development to improve how organizations operate and decide.

01 — Strategy and Workflow Design. Identifies workflows where analytics and AI create
measurable value, translating opportunities into implementation roadmaps.
Deliverables: Decision and workflow maps; Prioritized opportunities; Implementation guidance.

02 — Data Ingestion & Engineering. Connects fragmented data sources, establishes pipelines,
and improves data quality.
Deliverables: Automated pipelines; Structured data models; Validation controls.

03 — Machine Learning. Develops analytical systems around business decisions.
Deliverables: Predictive models; Decision-support systems; Explainability & monitoring.

04 — AI Application Development. Embeds insights into workflows through intelligent
assistants, document-processing systems, and custom applications.

Services function as one connected cycle: strategy informs decisions, data engineering
builds foundations, machine learning generates insights, and AI applications embed those
insights into workflows.

===============================================================================
SELECTED WORK  (/projects.html)
===============================================================================

We design data, analytics, machine-learning, and AI systems around real organizational
decisions and workflows. Our work spans public-health infrastructure, financial operations,
expense anomaly detection, logistics analytics, and predictive decision support.

Assessment of Pakistan's Public-Health Data Infrastructure. Azra Analytics performed a
countrywide evaluation of Pakistan's public-health data systems with U.S. CDC backing. The
initiative encompassed technical review of the National Health Data Center, capacity surveys
across 124 districts, and fieldwork at 81 health facilities spanning 39 districts. The team
examined data flows, reporting approaches, infrastructure conditions, data quality,
duplication concerns, and disease-surveillance mechanisms, then offered strategic
recommendations for system enhancement and integration.

Expense Anomaly Detection. Azra Analytics developed an anomaly-detection framework for five
years of expense transactions from a major leasing organization. The system combines
rule-based controls with Isolation Forest, Histogram-Based Outlier Scores, and denoising
autoencoder models to identify duplicate patterns, suspicious amounts, structural rarity,
and unusual combinations of transaction features. The framework includes data preparation,
model evaluation, multi-model anomaly comparison, explainability outputs, stakeholder
reporting, and deployment planning for both batch and individual transaction reviews.

Integrated Data and Safety Platform for Transportation. Azra Analytics designed a technical
architecture for a trucking and logistics company that integrates operational data from
multiple Google Sheets into a centralized data warehouse, automated ETL pipeline, REST API,
and dashboard-ready analytics layer. The project also uses millions of federal inspection
records to model weigh-station activity, predict inspection outcomes and depth, and identify
likely violation categories — giving managers, dispatchers, and drivers more timely,
consistent, and actionable information.

Data Ingestion Pipeline for PDFs and Document Images. Azra Analytics designed and prototyped
an on-premises AI platform that converts digital and scanned bank statements into validated
transaction data and automated financial reports, using document classification, OCR, large
language models, deterministic parsers, arithmetic validation, confidence scoring, and human
exception review — reducing manual data entry, strengthening auditability, protecting
sensitive financial data, and establishing a structured foundation for future risk analytics
and decision support.

research on convolutional neural networks received a Best Paper Award at an IEEE-sponsored
conference, and he has built applications that generate real-time predictions from audio

U.S. BUSINESS AI ADOPTION TRACKER  (/ai-adoption-tracker.html)
===============================================================================

Explore how businesses across the United States are adopting artificial intelligence, and
how adoption differs across states, industries, and firm sizes. The tracker transforms
recurring federal survey data into an interactive view of where AI use is growing, where
uncertainty remains, and which parts of the economy are moving fastest. Built and maintained
by Azra Analytics as a public data application — free to explore, no account required.
Interactive app: https://ai-adoption-tracker.onrender.com/

===============================================================================
AI & DATA READINESS ASSESSMENT  (/readiness.html)
===============================================================================

A free, self-service assessment that scores an organization's readiness to get value from
data and AI. Fifteen questions, about five minutes, answered about how the organization runs
today. Scoring is deterministic and runs entirely in the visitor's browser: no account, no
backend, and no data is transmitted unless the visitor chooses to email their results.

Premise: most AI projects fail not on the model but on the conditions around it — data that
could not be trusted, no owner for the output, or no prior agreement that anyone would act on
it. The assessment measures those conditions.

Five scored dimensions (0-100 each, three questions per dimension):
- Data foundations — whether the data behind important decisions exists, can be reached, and
  can be trusted.
- Governance & trust — whether numbers have owners, errors are caught before they reach a
  decision, and results can be explained afterward.
- Capability & ownership — who can build these systems, who keeps them running, and whether
  AI tool use is deliberate.
- Use-case pipeline — whether candidates are named, valued, and sequenced, and whether
  anything has reached production.
- Decision culture — whether evidence changes what people do, outputs reach a named
  decision-maker, and results get measured.

Overall bands: Exploring (0-34) — foundations not yet in place; the highest-return work is
defining decisions, making data reachable, and agreeing what the numbers mean. Building
(35-54) — real material and real gaps; the risk is starting several things and finishing
none. Operating (55-74) — conditions largely present; the constraint is sequencing and
follow-through. Compounding (75-100) — foundations, ownership, and culture in place; the
remaining leverage is ambition, reach, and measuring returns.

Output: an overall score and band, a radar profile across the five dimensions, a written
read on each dimension, and three prioritized next moves drawn from the lowest-scoring
dimensions. Each move is mapped to the Azra Analytics service line that carries it. Results
can be printed or saved as a PDF, copied as text, or emailed to omar@azraanalytics.com.
